gloss: to accomplish; to carry out; to execute

definitions.gloss: to accomplish; to carry out; to execute (a task or mission)
definitions.explanation: To carry something through to completion, especially a task, mission, or duty. Implies determination and thoroughness in seeing something through.

examples.japanese: {任務|にんむ}を{遂行|すいこう}する。
{計画|けいかく}を{確実|かくじつ}に{遂行|すいこう}する。
examples.english: To reliably carry out a plan.

examples.japanese: {困難|こんなん}な{状況|じょうきょう}でも{職務|しょくむ}を{遂行|すいこう}しなければならない。
examples.english: Even in difficult circumstances, one must carry out one's duties.

notes:
A する-verb from {遂行|すいこう}, a compound of {遂|すい} (accomplish, finally) and {行|こう} (perform). Formal and somewhat stiff; common in business, military, and official contexts. Emphasizes carrying a task through to completion.

TRANSITIVITY:
Transitive — takes を to mark the task being accomplished.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {任務|にんむ}を{遂行|すいこう}する — to carry out a mission
- {職務|しょくむ}を{遂行|すいこう}する — to perform one's duties
- {計画|けいかく}を{遂行|すいこう}する — to execute a plan
- {作戦|さくせん}を{遂行|すいこう}する — to carry out an operation

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {実行|じっこう}する — to execute, to carry out (more general, less formal)
- {履行|りこう}する — to fulfill (specifically obligations and contracts)
- {達成|たっせい}する — to achieve, to accomplish (focuses on reaching a goal)
